title: PD-EEG: Resting-State & Walking EEG in Parkinson's Disease
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 116 individuals with Parkinson's disease (PD) and 28 healthy controls, collected at the Neurology Institute, Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center. Recordings were obtained during resting-state (eyes open, sitting) and treadmill walking conditions, accompanied by clinical measures including MoCA, MDS-UPDRS, LEDD, and CTT scores. The dataset aims to support research into neurophysiological subtypes and gait-related cognitive-motor interactions in Parkinson's disease.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 64-channel Geodesic EEG System 400 (EGI system) with electrodes placed according to the International 10-20 system. Each participant completed two ~4-minute recordings: one during eyes-open resting sitting and one during treadmill walking at a comfortable speed while holding handrails. Additional clinical assessments (MoCA, MDS-UPDRS, LEDD, CTT) were collected alongside demographic data.
